title: Nuclear localization of Arabidopsis HD-Zip IV transcription factor GLABRA2 is driven by importin alpha.
authors: Ahmad, Bilal; Lerma-Reyes, Ruben; Mukherjee, Thiya; Nguyen, Hieu V; Weber, Audra L; Cummings, Emily E; Schulze, Waltraud X; Comer, Jeffrey R; Schrick, Kathrin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究拟南芥HD-Zip IV转录因子GL2的核定位由importin alpha驱动，涉及NLS与DNA结合功能分离及分子对接预测，属广义蛋白-DNA互作相关但非直接结合建模，方法含结构预测与对接，可借鉴至TF-DNA体系。
abstract: GLABRA2 (GL2), a class IV homeodomain leucine-zipper (HD-Zip IV) transcription factor from Arabidopsis, is a developmental regulator of specialized cell types in the epidermis. GL2 contains a monopartite nuclear localization sequence (NLS) that is conserved in most HD-Zip IV members across the plants. We demonstrate that NLS mutations affect nuclear transport and result in a loss-of-function phenotypes. NLS fusions to enhanced yellow fluorescent protein (EYFP) show that it is sufficient for nuclear localization in roots and trichomes. Despite partial overlap of the NLS with the homeodomain, genetic dissection indicates that nuclear localization and DNA binding are separable functions. Affinity purification of GL2 from plants followed by MS-based proteomics identified importin alpha (IMPalpha) isoforms as potential GL2 interactors. NLS structural prediction and molecular docking studies with IMPalpha-3 revealed major interacting residues. Cytosolic yeast two-hybrid assays and co-immunoprecipitation experiments with recombinant proteins verified NLS-dependent interactions between GL2 and several IMPalpha isoforms. IMPalpha triple mutants (impalpha-1,2,3) exhibit abnormal trichome formation and defects in GL2 nuclear localization in trichomes, consistent with tissue-specific and redundant functions of IMPalpha isoforms. Taken together, our findings provide mechanistic evidence for IMPalpha-dependent nuclear localization of GL2 in Arabidopsis, a process that is critical for cell type differentiation of the epidermis.
abstract_zh: GLABRA2 (GL2) 是来自拟南芥的一种IV类同源域亮氨酸拉链（HD-Zip IV）转录因子，是表皮中特化细胞类型的发育调控因子。GL2含有一个在植物界大多数HD-Zip IV成员中保守的单分型核定位序列（NLS）。我们证明NLS突变影响核转运并导致功能丧失表型。NLS与增强型黄色荧光蛋白（EYFP）的融合显示其足以在根和毛状体中实现核定位。尽管NLS与同源域部分重叠，但遗传解析表明核定位和DNA结合是可分离的功能。从植物中通过亲和纯化GL2并结合基于质谱的蛋白质组学鉴定出importin alpha（IMPalpha）亚型作为潜在的GL2互作因子。NLS结构预测及与IMPalpha-3的分子对接研究揭示了主要互作残基。胞质酵母双杂交实验和重组蛋白的免疫共沉淀实验验证了GL2与几种IMPalpha亚型之间的NLS依赖性互作。IMPalpha三重突变体（impalpha-1,2,3）表现出异常的毛状体形成和毛状体中GL2核定位缺陷，这与IMPalpha亚型的组织特异性和冗余功能一致。综上所述，我们的发现为拟南芥中IMPalpha依赖性GL2核定位提供了机制证据，这一过程对表皮细胞类型分化至关重要。
